name: SBY/BCS2019-04 Sunset Sky, Mai Sakurajima
ability: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, if you have 4 or more other 《Adolescence》 characters, choose 1 of your characters, and that character gets +1000 power and +1 soul until end of turn. 【AUTO】 This ability activates up to 1 time per turn. During the turn that this card is placed on the stage from your hand, if the damage dealt by this card is canceled, you may deal 1 damage to your opponent. (Damage may be canceled)
